entities.summary: Jonah Anthony Bolden is an Australian-American professional basketball player for the Illawarra Hawks of the National Basketball League (NBL). He started his professional career with FMP in Serbia, where he was named the ABA League Top Prospect in 2017. He played a season-and-a-half in the National Basketball Association (NBA) with the Philadelphia 76ers before joining the Phoenix Suns.
